source: Vriddha Yavana Jataka part one, sanskritdocuments.org e-text (encoded by Radu Canahai), ITRANS transliteration. Verses as typed there, with its errors. Chapters 28 (children) and 31 (manner of death) are deliberately not stored.

1.text: tanusthito vAsarapaH svatu~Nge / tIvrAM tanuM saMjanayennarANAm | / tu~NgAMshake vA dR^iDhatAsametAM / ShaDvargashuddho bahudhAryatAM cha

2.text: nIchAshritastIkShNaka\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / kAyaM vidhatte sarujaM sadaiva | / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. NyahInaM bhR^ishanichabhAge / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. varge nataye prayuktam

3.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi vAsaresho / mUrtiM gavo dIrghataraM prasUte | / mitrasya bhAge jatilaM nitAntaM / vargottame vAdhikashAsinaM cha

4.text: shatrorgR^ihe vA yadi tIkShNarashmirlagnAshrito hInasharIrakaM cha | / naraM prasUte tvatha shatrubhAge / hInakShakoNaM nayavarjitaM cha

5.text: chandro vilagne paripUrNadehastu~NgasthitaH saumyatanuM prasUte | / tu~Ngasya bhAge sumanoharAM cha / ShaDvargashuddho.aparanetrayuktAm

6.text: nIchAshritaH kShINatanuH shashA~NkaH / kANAM tanuM lagnagataH prasUte | / nishAndhakaM nIchanavAMshashaMsthaH / pApotthavarge timireNa yuktAm

7.text: mitragR^iha shItakarA vilagne / tanuM suvAte subhagAM manoj~nAm | / mitrasyabhAge varavaktrayuktAM / vargottamasthaH susharitakAntim

8.text: nishAndhakaM shatrugR^ihAshrite cha / lagnaM gataH sthUlaruDaM prasUte | / shatrorvibhAge pR^ithudIrghakaM cha / mUlatrikoNeShu shubhAdharauShTham

9.text: bhaumaH svatu~Nge mUrtisaMsthaH / karoti saMraktananIshamartyam | / tu~NgAMshake vA chipiTasvabhAvaM / ShaDvargashuddhastvatha karkashAkhyam

10.text: nIchashrito bhUtanayo vilagne / karoti sAndraM madanaM sadaiva | / nIchAMshake taimirikaM nishAndhaM / pApasya varge tvatha vakradR^iShTim

12.text: shatrorgR^ihe vA yadi bhUmiputro / mitraM prasUte bahudR^i\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / samIpadR^iShTiM cha navAMshake vA / mUlatrikoNe cha jalArdadR^iShTim

13.text: budhA vilagna yAda tu~NgasaMstho / naraM suvAte sumukhorunAsam | / tu~NgAMshake vA suradAdharaiShThaM / ShaDvargashuddhaH susharirakAntim

14.text: nIchAshrito vA yadi somaputrastanusthito vaktrakugandhabhAjam | / nIchAMshake dIrghakarAkajihvaM / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.

15.text: mitrAshrayasthA yadi somaputro / lagnaM gataH shubhrashiroruhaM cha | / mitrasya bhAge tvatha shubhradR^iShTi / vargittamasthaH suhanuM sadaiva

16.text: shatrorgR^ihe vA yadi somaputraH / karoti martyaM tanugaH karAlam | / shatrorvibhAge chapalasvabhAvaM / trikoNago rogavivR^iddhakAyam

17.text: surejyamantrI yadi tu~NgasaMstho / lagne manoj~naM janayenmanuShyam | / uchChAMshake vA shubhabAhuhastaM / ShaDvargashuddhaH shubhacharmabhAjam

18.text: nIchAshrito devagururvilagne / khaMjaM suvAte nirujaM nitAntam | / nIchAMshake khaMjananAsakaM cha / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. varge cha subhUShaNADhyam

19.text: mitrAshryastho yadi mUrtisaMstho / guruH prasUte varavastrabhAjam | / mitrAMshake vA sukaTiM sunAbhiM / vargottamasthaH subhagodaraM cha

20.text: shatrorgR^ihe tA yadi devapUjyo / mUrtisthitaH svodarikaM prasUte | / shatrorvibhAge tvatha phullameva / mUlatrikoNe prajanatyali~Ngam

21.text: shukraH svatu~Nge yadi lagnasaMsthaH / surUpajAnuM manujaM prasUte | / svochChAMshakasthaH shubhapANipAdaM / ShaDvargashuddhaH suvibhaktagAtram

22.text: nIchasthito vA yadi dAnavejyo / mUrtisthitaH svalpakachaM prasUte | / svalvATakaM vA yadi nIchahAge / pApAtthavarge baliromabhAjam

23.text: mitragR^ihastho yadi daityapUjyaH / saubhAgyayuktaM shubhakIrtibhAjam | / naraM prasUte sunakhaM vibhAge / vargottamastho bahurupiNaM cha

24.text: shukro yadA shatrugR^ihaM prapanno / lagnaM gataH kubjatanuM prasUte | / shatrorvibhAge.atikR^ishaM viga\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / mUlatrikoNe nayanAbhirAmam

25.text: shanaishcharo mUrtigataH svatu~Nge / lagnaM gataH shyAmatanuM manuShyam | / tu~NgAMshake sve tvatha bhinnavarNaM / ShaDvargashuddhastvatha gaura  \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. atram

26.text: nIchasthitaH sUryasuto vilagne / kAsArtamartyaM janayenamanuShyam | / nIchAshakasthaH kaphavAtapAtaM / pApasya varge tvatha pittatAM cha

27.text: mitrAshrayastho yadisUryasUnurlagnasthito gauravapuM prasUte | / mitrAMshakastho.asthasAyasAra / vargottamasthastvatha pIvarA~Ngam

28.text: shatrorgR^ihastho ravijo.atirUpyaM / lagnAshritaH sthUlanakhaM prasUte | / susthUladantaM ripubhAgasaMstho / mUlatrikoNe tu sudIrghajAnum

29.text: svochChasthitaH svabhavane kShitipAlatulyo / lagne.arkaje bhavati deshapurAdhinAthaH | / sheSheShu duHkhamadapIDita eva bAlye / dAridryakAmavyasano malino.alasashcha

1.text: sUryo dvitIye yadi tu~NgasaMstho / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. te nR^ipamAnajAtm | / uchChAMshake vA nR^ipasevakaM cha / ShaDvargashuddhaH shubhalokadattam

2.text: nIchAshrito bAsarapo dvitIye / pApArjitaM dharmadhanaM prasUte | / nIchAMshakasthaH sthalajaM sadaiva / pApasya varge tvatha chauryajaM cha

3.text: mitrAshrastho dinapo dvitIye / karoti jAtaM dhanadhAnyasambhavam | / mitrasya bhAge tvatha lohajAtaM / vargottamasthaH paradArajAtam

4.text: shatrorgR^ihe vA yadi tIkShNarashmirdvitIyagaH svalpadhanaM prasUte | / kaShTAntadeshe.adhamasavayA cha / mUlatrikoNe tvatha bhikShajaM cha

5.text: chandro dvitIye yadi tu~NgasaMsthe / muktAmaNiprAyabhanaM prasUte | / tu~NgAMshake vA kanakaM cha rUpyaM / ShaDvargashuddho vividhaM hiraNyam

6.text: nIchAshritaH shItakaraH prasUte / dvitIyago vittamasadvyayaM cha | / nIchasya bhAge ty vyayena hInaM / pApotthavarge vasavAM bhayaM cha

7.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi vA shashA~Nko / vittaM prasUte sutajaM narANAm | / mitrasya bhAge kR^iShikR^itprasUtaM / vargottamasthaH suhR^idarjitaM cha

8.text: shatrorgR^ihe vA yadi rAtrinAthaH / koshAshritachChauryadhanaM prasUte | / tadAMshake vAtha kukarmajAtaM / mUlatrikoNe tvatha bhAryajottham

9.text: bhaumaH svatu~Nge yadi koshagaH syAd / yuddhodbhavaM saMjanayeddhanaM cha | / uchChAMshake vAtikR^ishaM cha kaShTAt / ShaDvargashuddhaH svajanodbhavam cha

10.text: nIchAshrito bhUtanayastu nIche / dvItIyago nirdhanameva sUte | / nIchAMshake bahvraNameva nityaM / pApotthavarge vraNayuktadeham

11.text: mitragR^ihe vA yadi bhUmisute / koshAshrito mitrabalena jAtam | / dhanaM prasUte suhR^idaMshake cha / vargottame devaguruprasAdAt

12.text: shatrorgR^ihe bhUtanayo dvitIye / dhanaM prasUte na kadAchideva | / shatrorvibhAge dhR^iNapApasa~NgAn / mUlatrikoNe tu janoparodhAt

13.text: saumyasvatu~Nge yadi koshasaMsthaH / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. naM bhUridhanasya dhatte | / tu~NgAMshake sasyachatuShpadAttha / ShaDvargashuddho vividhairUpayaiH

14.text: nIchAshritaH somasuto dhanastho / nikR^iShTavittaM kurute narANAm | / nIchAMshakastho riputo.atidainyAt / pApotthavarge bahuvaMchanAshcha

15.text: mitrAshritasthe yadisomaputro / dvitIyago vAjijameva vittam | / dhatte narANAM chaM suhR^idvibhAge / vargottame vA sukR^itaM prasUte

16.text: buddho yadA shatrugR^ihaM prayAto / dvitIyagaH shatrunIShevaNena | / dhanaM bhavecChatruvi\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / tvalpaM trikoNe varalokajAtam

17.text: jIvo dvitIye yadi tu~Nga / sadA dhanaM nyAyajitaM prasUte | / tu~NgAMshake cha dvijasAdhuvR^itta / ShaDvargashuddho nR^ipasaMbhavaM cha

18.text: nIchAshrito devagururdvitIye / dhanaM prasUte paradArajAtam | / nIchAMshake chAntyajalokajAtaM / pApasya varge bahukaShTajAtam

19.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi devamantrI / dvitIyago vastragajAshchajaM cha | / dhatte tadaMshe na kR^iShiprasUtaM / vargottamasyaH sujanapradantam

20.text: yadA dvitIye.arigR^ihe surejyo / vidhatte.ariniShevaNena | / shatrvaMshake shatrujanena dattaM / mUlatrikoNe nidhijaM sadaiva

21.text: shukre dvitIye yadi tu~NgasaMsthaH / sadAkShayaM bhUridhanaM prasUte | / tu~NgAMshake pUrvajasaMchitaM cha / ShaDvargashuddho dvitayaM nitAntam

22.text: nIchAshito daityagururdvitIye / dhanaM suvAte shrutijaM nitAntam | / dyUtarjitaM nIchanavAMshasaMsthaH / pApasya varg paradeshasa~gAt

23.text: mitrAshryastho yadi dAnavejyo / dvitIyasaMstho nR^ipajaM vidhatte | / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. nnaM tadashaM nR^ipaputrajAta / rAj~nI\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. mutthaM yadi shubhavarge

24.text: shukro dvitIye yadi shatrusaMstho / dhanaM prasUte varakarmajAtam | / shatrorvibhAge tvatha dainyajAtaM / mUlatrikoNe svasutArjitaM cha

25.text: shAnirdvitIye yadi tu~NgasaMstho / dhanaM prasUte tu kukarmajAtam | / tadaMshake kaShTavinirjitaM cha / ShaDvargashudho vyasanodbhavaM cha

26.text: nIchaM gato bhAskarajaH prasUte / niHkichanaM nityamanekaduHkham | / naraM tadaMshe.antyajavittabhAjaM / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. varge tu supApajaM cha

27.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi sUryaputro / dvitIyagaH svasthadhanaM prasUte | / mitrasya bhAge tvatha mR^inmayaM cha / vargottamastho jalajaM sadaiva

28.text: sauro yadA shatrugR^ihAshrayastho / dvitIyagaH pApadhanaM prasUte | / shatrorvibhage bahudAsatotthaM / mUlatrikoNe parapoSha cha

29.text: sahasranAtho dinapH pradiShTo / lakShAdhipo ratrikaraH sadaiva | / shatAdhipo bhUtanayaH sadaiva / koTIshcharaH somasutaH sadaiva

30.text: svarvAdhinAthaH surarAjamantrI / shukro hyasaMkhyaH shanirbhaumatulyaH | / svatu~NgAH syuryadi sarva eva / arthAntarAle tvanupAtajAtam

31.text: svavargajaM vittamaho dadhatti / hitvA hi shukraM bahusa~NgajaM cha | / svaM svaM dhanaM svAsu dashAsu samyak / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.

1.text: tR^itIyasaMstho yadi vAsaresho / mitraM nR^ipaM tu~Ngagato vidhatte | / tu~NgAMshake vA nR^ipasaMbhavaM cha / ShaDvargashuddhastvatha sArvabhaumam

2.text: nIchAshrito nIchadhanaM vidhatte / mitraM tR^itIye yadi tIkShNarashmiH | / nIchAMshake bhikShukaputravairaM / pApasya varge tvatha vAraNaM  cha

3.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi vAsarashI / mitraM dvijendraM kurute tR^itIye | / mitrAMshakastho janayet sushIlaM / vargottamastho.adbhutashAstraraktam

4.text: ravitR^itIye.arigR^ihaM prayAto / mitraM vidhatte ripuvarjitA~Ngam | / dviShavibhAge guNavarjitaM cha / mUlatrikoNe patimeva shAntam

5.text: tR^itIyagaH shItakaraH suvAte / mitraM svatu~Nge kR^ipaNasvabhAvam | / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. meva bhAge paratarkakaM cha / ShaDvargashuddhaH paradAraraktam

6.text: nIchAshrito rAtripatistR^itIye / mitraM svAte.atyajameva nityam | / nIchasya bhAge tvatha nartakaM cha / bhaNDaM cha varge khalasambhavaM cha

7.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi shItarashmirmitraM suvAte paravaMchakaM cha | / mitrasya bhAge bahudoShajaM cha / vargottamastho ghR^iNayA vihInam

8.text: tR^itIyagaH shItakaro vidhatte / narAdhamaM shatrugR^ihaM prayAtaH | / shatrorvibhAge bahumAyayADhyaM / mUlatrikoNe paradAraraktam

9.text: bhaumastR^itIye yadi tu~NgasaMstho / mitraM vidhatte varabhUmipAlam | / tu~NgAMshake vA nR^ipateramAtyaM / ShaDvargashuddho dvitayaM sadaiva

10.text: nIchAshrito bhUtanayastR^itIye / mitraM vidhatte bahukAmasaktam | / nIchAMshakastho bhR^itakaM cha vaidyaM / pApotthavarge vyasanAbhibhUtam

11.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi bhUmiputrastR^itIyago bhUrisukhaM prasUte | / mitrAMshake vAkShayajaM kumAraM / vargottamasthaH prachurAnnapAnam

12.text: shatrorgR^ihastho yadi bhUmiputro / mitraM prasUte sahajAshritaM cha | / tasthaiva bhAge cha samR^iddhibhAjaM / mUlatrikoNe tvatha daNDanAtham

13.text: saumyastR^itIye yadi tu~NgasaMstho / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. shAntamatiM prasUte | / tu~NgAMshake kaMchakina sama\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / ShaDvargashuddhaH sutarA kR^it \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. m

14.text: nIchAritaH somasutastR^itIye / mitraM vidhatte vR^ijinaiH sametam | / gopAlakaM nIchavibhAgasaMsthaH / pApasya varge gatasauhR^idaM cha

15.text: mitrAshrayasthaH shaijastR^itIya / mitraM suvAte bahukarmabhAjam | / bhAge tvatha nApitaM cha / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. khala\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. ram

16.text: shatrorgR^ihastho yadi somaputro / mitraM tR^itIye kurute sunindham | / tasthaiva bhAge janitAtigaM cha / mUlatrikoNe.atha malimlucham cha

17.text: nIchastR^itIye yadi tu~NgasaMstho / mitraM suvAt vinayena hInam | / uchChAMshake dambhaparaM nR^ishaMsaM / ShaDvargashuddhastu tathAprajaM cha

18.text: nIchAshrito devagurustR^itIye / mitraM prasUte bahupAchitAram | / tadaMshake dyUtarataM sadaiva / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. varge gatabadhuvargam

19.text: jIvo yadA mitragR^ihe tR^itIye / tadA prasUte.atikR^ishaM cha mitram | / mitrAMshake paNyaparaM pradhAnaM / vargottamasthaH khalu dantakAram

20.text: tR^itIyago devagururya\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / shatrorgR^ihe klIvasukhaM suvAte | / tadaMshake shilpinamapradhAnaM / mUlatrikoNe patitaM nikR^iShTam

21.text: shukro yadA tu~NgatastR^itIye / tadA suvAte patitaM cha mitram | / tu~NgAMshake vA nR^ipasevakaM cha / ShaDvargashuddhaM kalahapriyaM cha

22.text: nIchAshrito daityagurustR^itIye / mitraM vidhatte vadhakaM nR^ishaMsham | / nIchAMshake nichakulaprasUtaM / pApasya varge patitaM nR^ishaMsam

23.text: mitrAshrayastho bhR^igujastR^itIye / karoti mitraM khalu bhANDamva | / mitAMshake vAraNamaprashastaM / vargottamasthaH shabaraM kR^itaghnam

24.text: riporgR^ihe bhArgavajaH prasUte / tR^itIyagaH krIDanakaM cha mitram | / tadaMshake shilpinamaprashastaM / mUlatrikoNe.atha janairnirastam

25.text: sUryAtmajastu~NgatastR^itIye / mitraM suvAte varabhUmipAlam | / tu~NgAMshake vittapatiM prasiddhaM / ShaDvargashuddho bahushAstraraktam

26.text: nIchAshritaH sUryasutatR^itIye / mitraM prasUte malinasvabhAvam | / nIchAMshake vaMchanatatparaM cha / pApasya varge ghR^inathA vihInam

27.text: mitrAshrayasthaH khalu sUryaputro / mitraM prasUte sachivaM nayacham | / mitrAMshake vA guNavittabhAjaM / vargottamastha sthitimAnayuktam

28.text: shaniryadA shatrugR^ihAshrayasthastR^itIyagaH pAparataM cha mitram | / dhatte tadaMshe vR^ijinaM sudInaM / mUlatrikoNe vijitAripakSham

29.text: \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. sAvatA pravi / dashAdhipaH shItkarastu \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / sahasramitraH kShitijo \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. u\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / shatAdhipo devapurohitashcha

30.text: ashItinAtho bhR^iguna. \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / saurastu bhaumema \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. mito.adhiko vA | / svatu~NgarAshau yadi vattamAnAH / sarve \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. u\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.atasya vashAddadanti

1.text: \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. bahuduShTajAtam | / tu~NgAMshakastho.aNusukhaM kadAchit / ShaDvargashuddhaH paradArashchaM cha

2.text: nIchAshrito vAsarapashchaturthe / sukhaM vidhatte na kadAchideva | / nichAMshake duHkhavimishritaM cha / pApasya varge dhR^iNaduHkhamishram

3.text: mitrAshrayastho dinakR^ishchaturthe / sukhaM vidhatte vR^ijinaiH sametam | / chauryadbhavaM shatruvibhAgasaMstho / vargottamastho.akShajameva nityam

4.text: shatrorgR^ihe vAsarapashchaturthe / yuddhe tu saukhyaM kurute narANAm | / shatrorvibhAge parasevayA cha / mUlatrikoNe vadhavandhajAtam

5.text: sukhasthitaH shItakaraH svatu~Nge / sukhaM vidhatte gajavAjijAtam | / tu~NgAMshake hemasamudbhavaM cha / ShaDvargashuddho vividhaM sadaiva

6.text: nIchAshritaH shItakaraH \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / sukhaM sadA dyUtajameva puMsAm | / nIchAMshake bhUrikR^iShiprasUtaM / pApasya varge bahupApajAtam

7.text: mitrAshrayasthaH khalu shItarashmiH / sukhasthito bhUrisukhaM vidhatte | / sutAdbhava mitrAvabhAgasaMstho / vargottamastho vanitodbhavaM cha

8.text: chaturthago rAtripatiH prasUte / shatrorgR^ihe saukhyamanItijAtam | / shatrorvibhAge kapaTaprasUta / mUlatrikoNe tvatha dharmajAtam

9.text: chaturtho bhUtanayaH svatu~Nge / sukhaM vidhatte parasUdanena / tu~NgAMshakasthaH parabandhanena / ShaDvargashuddhaH paravaMchanena

10.text: sukhAshrito bhUmisutastu nIche / saukhyaM kadAchinna karoti puMsAm | / nIchAMshakasthaH parapoShaNena / pApatya varge vadhabandhanena

11.text: mitrArayasthaH kShitijashchaturthe / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. paradeshayogAt | / mitrAMshakasthaH surataprasa~Nga\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / vargottamasthaH paravittanAshAt

12.text: shatrorgR^ihe syAdhadi bhUmiputrarchaturthagaH puMshchalajaM cha saukhyam | / dhatte tadaMshe karayonijAtaM / mUlatrikoNe sukhamohanADhyam

13.text: saumyaH sukhasthaH sukhameva dhatte / mahAjanotthaM yadi tu~NgasaMsthaH | / tu~NgAMshake pArthivajaM cha puMsAM / ShaDvargashuddho vyayameva puMsAm

14.text: nIchAshrayasthaH shashijo vidhatte / chaturthagaH kleshajameva saukhyam | / nIchAMshakasthaH parasevayA cha / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. ativirgahaNena

15.text: mitrAshrayasthaH shashijashchaturthe / sukhaM vidhatte varaputrajAtam | / mitrAMshakasthastu kalatrajAtaM / vargottamastho duhitodbhavaM cha

16.text: shatrvAshrayasthaH shashijashchaturthe / sukhaM vidhatte krayavikrayeNa | / tasyaiva bhAge pashupAlanena / mUlatrikoNe nijabandhavottham

17.text: jIvashchaturthe yadi tu~NgasaMstho / sukhaM vidhatte sakalaM sadaiva | / tu~Ngasya bhAge cha tathA tadardhaM / ShaDvargashudhashcha sudharmayuktam

18.text: nIchAshrito devagurushchaturthe / saukhyaM vidhatte bahunIchasa~NgAt | / nIchAMshakasthashcha vichitrabhAvAt / pApasya varge parapoShaNena

19.text: mitrAshrayasthe surarAjapUjye / chaturthage vaMshajameva saukhyam | / bhavettadaMshe bahubhR^ityajAta / vargottamasthe bhaginIsamuttham

20.text: shatrorgR^ihatho yadi devapUjya\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / schaturthago nIchaniShevaNena | / saukhyaM vidhatte.atha tadaMshake vA / mUlatrikoNe nR^ipasa~Ngamena

21.text: shukraH svatu~Nge yadi bandhu\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / sukhaM vidhatte bahuvittajAtam | / tu~NgAMshakasthastu svaroShTrajAtaM / ShaDvargashuddhashcha gajodbhavaM cha

22.text: nIchAshrayastho yadi daityamantrI / sukhaM vidhatte paranArijAtam | / nIchAMshake chaiva vilAsinInAM / pApasya varge gurupatnisa~NgAt

23.text: mitrAshrayastho bhR^igushchaturthe / saukhyaM vidhatte bahugodhanottham | / mitrAMshake.ajAvikameva nityaM / vargottamastho mahiShIsamuttham

24.text: shatrorgR^ihastho yadi daityapUjyaH / sukhaM vidhatte kuniShevaNena | / tadaMshake vA paradeshavAsAn / mUlatrikoNe dvijadevasa~NgAt

25.text: shaniH sukhastho yadi tu~NgasaMsthaH / sukhaM vidhatte mR^igapakShinAshAt | / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. ake vA viShabhakShiNena \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / ShaDvargashuddhaH kR^iShikarmajAtam

26.text: nIchAshrito bhAskarajaH prasUte / chaturthagaH saukhyavinA manuShyam | / nIchAMshake lokanibandhanena / pApasya varge pararandhrasa~NgAt

27.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / vidhatte svakalatrabhuktam | / mitrAMshake vA svakutumbahInaM / vargottamasthaH parapIDanena

28.text: \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. rAnajaH prasUte / sukhaM chaturthe paravaMchanena | / tadaMshake mAnuShavikrayeNa / mUlatrikoNe krayavikrayeNa

29.text: saukhyaH surarAjamantrI \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / shatAdhipaH somasutaH sitashcha | / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. alI / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. yAdhipAH sUryashanaishcharArAH

30.text: svatu~NgasaMstha\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / saukhyAni yacChanti sadA grahendrAH | / nIchAshritA hInasukhA bhavanti / ShaDvargashuddhAshcha yathA svatu~Nge

1.text: \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. vAsarapo.arisaMsthaH / shatruM vidhatte vratinaM sadaiva | / tu~NgAMshakasthita atha viprameva / ShaDvargashuddho nR^ipatiM sadaiva

2.text: nIchAshrayasthaH savitArisaMsthaH / shatruM vidhatte kumatiM kR^itaghnam | / nIchAMshakasthaH pramadAnuraktaM / pApasya varge paratarkakaM cha

3.text: suhR^idgR^ihasthaH savitArisaMsthaH / shatruM vidhatte vaNijAnuraktam | / mitrAMshakasthastvatha gAjapAla / vargottamastho bahushiShyabhAjam

4.text: shatrvAshrayastho yadi tIkShNarashmiH / ShaShThe vidhatte pramadAsamuttham | / vairaM tadamshe tvatha paMshchalIbhIrmUlatrikoNe cha vilAsinIbhiH

5.text: chandro.arisaMstho yadi tu~NgasaMthaH / shatruM vidhatte bahushAstraraktam | / uchChAMshake vA paradAraraktaM / ShaDvargashuddho.apyatha pArthivaM cha

6.text: nIchAshritaH shItakaro.arisaMstho / mitraM na kiMchit kurute marANAm | / nichAMshakasthashcha bahuprakAraM / vairaM vavarNena khalotthavarge

7.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi shItarashmiH / ShaShThasthito.ariM nR^ipatiM prasUte | / mitrAMshakasthastu narendraputraM / vargottamasthaH satataM nR^ishaMsam

8.text: shatrvAshrayastho yadi shItarashmiH / shatruM vidhatte vikR^itasvabhAvam | / tasyaiva bhAge hyatha sainyanAthaM / mUlatrikoNe guruvatsanaM cha

9.text: tu~NgAshrito bhUtanayastu ShaShThe / shatruM na puMsAM kurute kadAchit | / tu~NgAMshake chAtha sudInacheShTaM / ShaDvargashuddhaH paradeshabhAjam

10.text: bhaumo.arisaMstho yadi nIchasaMsthaH / shatruM vidhatte.antyajameva puMsAm | / nIchAMshake vA kR^iShikarmaraktaM / pApasya varge dhanadhAnyahInam

11.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi bhUmiputraH / ShaShthe prasUte tanayena vairam | / mitrAMshake vA tvatha bAndhavena / vargottamastho nijamAtulena

12.text: bhaumo.arisaMstho yadi shatrurAshau / ripuM vidhatte gurudevatArim | / tasyaiva bhAge ghR^iNayA vihInaM / mUlatrikoNe priyasAhasaM cha

13.text: saumyo.arisaMstho yadi tu~NgasaMsthaH / shatruM vidhatte vikR^itavabhAvam | / tu~NgAMshake vA dhaninaM virUpaM / ShaDvargashuddhaH suratAnukUlam

14.text: budho.arisaMstho yadi nIcharAshau / shatruM suvAte vikalaM vinetram | / kANaM tadaMshe vikR^itAMghR^idaMShtraM / pApastha varge dvijadhAmaraktam

15.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi somaputraH / ShaShthe vidhatte sachivaM hi mitram | / mitrAmshakasthaH sachivasya putraM / ShaDvargashuddhaH paradAraraktam

16.text: shatrorgR^ihastho yadi somaputraH / shatruM vidhatte paravintaraktam | / chauraM tadaMshe satataM nR^ishaMsaM / mUlatrikoNe vyasanAbhibhUtam

17.text: jIvaH svatu~Nge yadi ShaShThasaMsthaH / shatruM prasUte bahudoShabhAjam | / tu~NgAMshake \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. rivivarjitaM cha / ShaDvargashuddhaH pramadAnukUlam

18.text: nIchAshraye vA yadi devapUjyaH / ShaShthe prasUte.alpasukhaM cha saktam | / tadaMshake vA bahupAnaraktaM / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. varge guNavarjitaM cha

19.text: mitrAshraya\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. yadi devamantrI / shatruM suvAtte.a\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. patiM prasiddham | / tadaMshake vA kharagardabhADhyaM / vargottamasthaH shrutavarjitaM cha

20.text: shatrvAshryasthaH kurute surejyaH / shatruM vihInaM nijabandhuvarge | / shatrorvibhAge vinayena hInaM / mUlatrikoNe bahuputrapautram

21.text: shukraH svatu~Nge yadi shatrusaMsthaH / shatruM vidhatte jitashatrupakSham | / tu~NgAMshake vA jitashatrudAraM / ShaDvargashuddhaH praNatAripakSham

22.text: nIchAshrayastho ripugo.asurejyaH / shatruM prasUte bahukanyakADhyam | / nIchAMshakasthastu gajAdhinAthaM / pApasya varge kR^itapApasa~Ngam

23.text: mitrAshrayastho ripugo vidhatte / shukro ripuM bandhavavarganeva | / tadaMshake vA svakalatravarge / vargottamasthaH shvashuraM sadaiva

24.text: shatrvAshrayastho.arigatastu shukro / ripuM prasUte sutarAM nR^ishaMsam | / tasyAMshake vyAdhuvivarjitA~NgaM / mUlatrikoNe dhanavarjitaM cha

25.text: shanaishcharaH ShaShThagataH svatu~Nge / parairvihInaM janayenmanuShyam | / tu~NgAMshake svalparipuM jitAriM / ShaDvargashuddhaH sunataM paraishcha

26.text: nIchAshrayastho yadi sUryaputraH / shatruM prasUte taralaM manuShyam | / nIchasya bhAge kanakADhyameva / pApasya varge kR^iShikarmadakSham

27.text: mitrAshrayastho ravijo.arisaMsthaH / shaThaM ripuM svalpatanuM prasUte | / mitrasya bhAge haninaM pradhAnaM / vargottamastho bahukarmayuktam

28.text: shatrvAshrayastho ravijo ripusthaH / shatruM suvAte satataM gatArtham | / shatrorvibhAge sutadArahInaM / mUlatrikoNe parasa~NgataM cha

29.text: dashAdhipastIkShNakaraH pradiShtaM / sahatranAtho rajanIpatishcha / vakrArkajau hInaparau sadaiva / seShAstu chandreNa samAH svatu~Nge

1.text: dinAdhipaH saptamagaH svatu~Nge / karoti bhAryaM kalahapriyAM cha | / tu~NgAMshakasthaH parakarmaraktAM / ShaDvargashuddhatu daridrayuktAm

2.text: nIchAshritaH saptamagastu sUryo / bhAryAM vidhatte vyadhichAriNIM cha | / nIchAMshakasthashcha sarogayuktAM / pApasya varge satataM kushIlAm

3.text: mitrAshrayastho dinapaH kalatre / karoti bhAryAM sutarAM nR^ishaMsAm | / mitrasya bhAge suvihInachintAM / vargottamasthaH suratapriyAM cha

4.text: shatrvAshrayastho yadi vAsareshaH / karoti bhAryAM vyasanAbhibhUtAm | / shatrorvibhage parahInakR^ityAM / mUlatrikoNe priyasAdhvasAM cha

5.text: chandrastu kAm yadi tu~NgasaMstho / bhAryAM vidhatte subhagAM manoj~nAm | / tu~NgAMshake vA suradevabhaktAM / ShaDvargashuddho.atimanoshcharUpAm

6.text: nishAkaraH kAmagataH svanIche / bhAryAm vidhatte bahurogabhAjAm | / nIchAMshake kuShTharujA sametAM / pApasya varge patinA virudhAm

7.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi rAtrinAtho / bhAryAM prasUte priyavAdinIM cha | / mitrAMshake vA vinayena yuktAM / vargottamastho bahukarmayuktAm

8.text: shatrvAshrayastho yadi rAtrinAtho / viruddhacheShTAM janayeshcha bhAryAm | / shatrorvibhAge vigataprabhAvAM / mUlatrikoNe bahubhR^ityadakShAm

9.text: dharAsutaH kAtaH kAmagateH svatu~Nge / bhAryAM vidhatte gatarUpavittAm | / tu~NgAMshake vAtijarAbhibhUtAM / ShaDvargashuddhaH prachitaprabhAvAm

10.text: nIchAshrayasthaH kShitijastu kAme / dAraM vidhatte prachurapragalbham | / nIchAMshake vA bahushatrupakShAM / pApasya varge nijavargahInAm

11.text: mitrAshrayasthaH kShitijaH kalatre / bhAryAM suvAte laghucholanAM cha | / mitrasya bhAge.alpasaroruDAkShIM / vargottamasthaH prabhutAvihInAm

12.text: shatrvAshrayastho yadi bhUmiputro / bhAryAM vidhatte kaThinasvabhAvAm | / tadaMshake vA hatabandhivargAM / mUlatrikoNe parasa~NgatAM cha

13.text: kAmAshrayasthaH shashijaH svatu~Nge / bhAryAM vidhatte.adbhutarUpayuktAm | / tu~NgAMshake vA bahubhoyuktAM / ShaDvargashuddhaH kR^itamaNDanAM cha

14.text: nIche cha saumyaH khalu saptamasthaH / karoti bhAryAM kunarAnuraktAm | / nIchAMshake vA vyasanAnuraktaM / pApasya varge guNavarjitAM cha

15.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi somaputro / dAraM prasUte bahuputraputram | / mitrAMshake vA prachurAnnapAnAM / vargottamasthaH prabhayA sametAm

16.text: shatrvAshrayasthe yadi kAmago j~no / bhAryAM suvAte.arthavivarjitAM cha | / tadaMshake vA dhanadhAnyahInAM / mUlatrikoNe janavallabhAM cha

17.text: jIvaH kalatre yadi tu~NgasaMsthaH / karoti dAraM priyadarshanaM cha | / tu~NgAMshakastho bahusaukhyayuktAM / ShaDvargashuddhaH sukulodbhavAM cha

18.text: nIchAshrito devaguruH kalatre / dAre vidhatte na kulodbhavaM cha | / nIchAMshakastho bahumAnayuktAM / pApasya varge pishunasvabhAvAm

19.text: mitrAshrayastho madane surejyo / dAraM vidhatte bahusAdhumitram | / mitrAMshakastho maNimauktikADhyaM / vargottamastho.ativishuddhakAyAm

20.text: shatrvAshrayastho madane surejyo / dAraM vidhatte chapalasvabhAvam | / parAMshakastho.atikaThoravAkyAM / mUlatrikoNe guNavarjitAM cha

21.text: shukroshchasaMstho yadi saptamastho / bhAryAM suvate bahumitrapakShAm | / tu~NgAMshakastho dvijadevabhaktAM / ShaDvargashuddhastu pativratAM cha

22.text: nIchAshrito daityaguruH kalatre / kalatramuchChaiH kurute prAnnam | / nIchAMshakasthastu surUpanetrAM / pApasya varge ghR^iNayA vihInAm

23.text: mitrAshrayasthaH kurute cha shukraH / kAme sukAmAM subhagAM cha bhAryAm | / mitrAMshakasthashcha sushuddhachintAM / vargottamastho janavallabhAM cha

24.text: shatrvAshrayastho bhR^igujastu kAme / bhAryAM uvAte sutarAM prahInAm | / tadaMshakastho.aprakR^itasvabhAvAM / mUlatrikoNe susamanvitAM cha

25.text: shanaishcharastu~NgataH kalatre / sthUlaM kalatraM kurute narANAm | / tu~NgAMshakasthashcha sukR^iShNagAtrAM / ShaDvargashuddho bahuduHkhabhAjAm

26.text: nIchAshritaH kAmagatastu koNo / dAraM prasUte vikarAlagAtram | / nIchAMshakasthashcha vihInadharmAM / pApasya varge pararaktachintAm

27.text: mitrAshrayasthaH prakaroti sauraH / kAmAshritaH kopaparaM kalatram | / mitrasyabhAge guNavarjitA~NgAM / pApasya varge.atikhalasvabhAvAm

28.text: shatrvAshrayastho ravijaH kalatre / dAraM prasUte bahupAparaktam | / tasthaiva bhAge patininditAM cha / mUlatrikoNe vidhanAM sadaiva

29.text: pachAdhipo devaguruH sitashcha / somo visaMkhyaH shashijo gaNAnAm | / ekAdhipAH sUryashanaishcharArAH / svatu~NgagAH syuryadi sadgrahendrAH

1.text: dharmAshrito vAsarapaH svatu~Nge / dharmaM nR^iNAM tApasameva dhatte | / tu~NgAMshasaMsthastvatha dambhadaM cha / ShaDvargashuddhastvatha vajjayA cha

2.text: nIchAshrayasthe dinapastu dharme / dharmeNa hInaM janayenmanuShyam | / nIchAMshakasthashcha kukarmaraktaM / pApasya varge paradharmaraktam

3.text: mitrAshrayastho dinapastu dharme / kaulotthadharmaM kurute narANAm | / mitrAMshake vaikR^itikaM tathaiva / vargottamastho.atilaghupramANam

4.text: shatrvAshrayastho dinapastu dharme / kR^itaghnadharmaM kurute narANAm | / tadaMshakasthastvatha chaurajaM cha / mUlatrikoNe.atisukhotthameva

5.text: chandraH svatu~Nge yadi dharmasaMsthaH / prasAddharmaM kurute narANAm | / tadaMshasaMshthashcha tadAgajaM cha / ShaDvargashuddho dvijA\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. dAnajaM cha

7.text: mitrAshrayastho himagushcha dharme / dharmaM vidhate svakuTumbada\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / tadaMshake mitrajanotthameva \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / vargottamastho.atra samR^iddhidam

8.text: shtrvAshrayastho himagushcha dharme / dharmaM prasUte viTapAtradAnAt | / tadaMshakasthaH pramadAnusa~NgAn / mUlatrikoNe bahuvittadAnAt

9.text: bhaumaH svatu~Nge yadi dharmasaMstho / dharmaM prasUte raNajaM narANAm | / tu~NgAMshakasthaH parasevayA cha / ShaDvargashuddho gurupoShaNena

10.text: nIchAshrayasthaH kShitijastu dharme / dharmaM vidhatte \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / tadaNshakasthaH paradAralAbhAt / pApasya varge janatAparodhAt

11.text: mitrAshrayastha kShitijastu dharme / dharmaM vidhatte suhR^idaprakopAt | / tasthaiva bhAge bahukopatashcha / vargottamasthaH parasevayA cha

12.text: shatrvAshrayasthaH kShitijastu dharme / dharmaM vidhatte na kadAchideva | / tadAMshakasthaH kanachauraNAnAM / mUlatrikoNe namitArjitena

13.text: dharmAshritaH somasutaH svatu~Nge / dharmaM vidhatte varashatrujAtam | / tadaMshakastho dvijadevatAnAM / ShaDvargashudho vratapAlanena

14.text: nIchAshrayasthaH shashijastu dharme / dharmaM prasUte kapadena puMsAm | / tadaMshakasthaH kuhakaprayogaiH / pApasyavarge.atha Chalena nityam

15.text: mitrAshrayastha shashijastu dharme / dharmaM prasUte gR^ihadAnatashcha | / mitrAMshake tApasameva nityaM / vargottamastho bahuvastradAnAt

16.text: shatrvashryathaH shashijastu dharme / dharmaM vidhatte.akShavivarjitaM cha | / tasyaiva bhAge gurulokAbhAn / mUlatrikoNe bahushAntyameva

17.text: dharmAshrito devaguruH svatu~Nge / dharmaM vidhatte pracharaM sadaiva | / tadaMshakastho \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / ShaDvargashuddho drutameva puMsAm

18.text: nIchAshthito devagurushcha dharme / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. suvAte kR^itakaM narANAm | / nIchAMshakastho guruNAnurodhAt / pApasya varge bahutIrthasa~NgAt

19.text: mitrAshrayasthaH surarAjamantrI / dharmaM vidhatte bahudharmamArgAt | / mitrAMshakastho vanitAmatena / vargottamasthastanayAnusa~NgAt

20.text: shatrvAshrayasthaH kurute surejyo / dharme narANAM sunayena dharmam | / tadaMshakastho gurupoShaNena / mUlatrikoNe ghR^iNayAnurodhAt

21.text: shukroshchasaMstho yadi dharmasaMstho / dharmaM prasUte varadAnajAtam | / \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. AnnajaM tasya vibhAgasaMsthaH / ShaDvargashuddhaH pitR^itarpaNena

22.text: nIchAMshakastho bhR^igujashcha dharme / dharmaM prasUte paradeshasa~NgAt | / tadaMshakastho.adhvagalokasa~NgAt / vargottamasthaH sumukhairanekaiH

23.text: mitrAshrayastho bhR^igujastu dharme / dharmaM suvAte.alpaphalaM narANAm | / tasthaiva bhAge cha vinisayena / pApasya varge paravaMchanena

24.text: shatrvAshrayastho bhR^igujashcha dharme / dharmaM prasUte paralokasa~NgAt | / tadaMshakastho.ariniShevaNena / mUlatrikoNe kR^iShikarmalAbhAt

25.text: shanaishcharastu~Ngatastu dharme / dharmaM vidhatte vayasi tR^itIye | / tadaMshakastho.alpataraM paraM cha / ShaDvargauddhastvatha bhaktibAhyam

26.text: nIchAshritaH sUryautastu dharme / dharmeNa hInaM janayenmanuShyam | / tadaMshakasthaH paradharmaraktaM / pApasya varge kavalodbhavaM cha

27.text: mitrAshrayastho.arkasutastu dharme / dharmaM vidhatte satataM sugarham | / tadaMshakasthastrayaja\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / vargottamastho nR^ipasevayA cha

28.text: shatrvAshrayastho.arkasutastu dharme / kR^icCheNa dharmaM janayet susUkShmam | / tadaMshasthaH paradarshanotthaM / mUlatrikoNe gurulabdhamAnAt

1.text: karmAshritastIkShNakaraH svatu~Nge / karoti karma vratakR^ityameva | / tadaMshakastho vadhabandhajaM cha / ShaDvargashuddhaH sakalaM kalAjam

2.text: nIchAshritastIkShNakaro.ambarastho / nR^iNAM vidhatte bahudAsakarma | / tasyaiva bhAge vaNijodbhavaM cha / vargottamastho vaNijaprasUtam

3.text: mitrAshrayastho dinakR^it khasaMsthaH / karoti puMsAM kR^iShijaM cha karma | / mitrasya bhage kunR^ipasya sevajaM / pApasya varge vadhabandhajam

4.text: shatrvAshrayastho dinapo narANA / dadAti karmAshubhameva nityam | / tasyaiva bhAge janagarhitaM cha / mUlatrikoNe kharasevajaM cha

5.text: karmAshritaH shItakaraH svatu~Nge / karoti karma prathitaM nR^iloke | / tasyaiva bhAge dvijadevajaM cha / Shadvargashuddho varadAnabhAjam

6.text: nIchAshritaH shItakaro.ambarastho / dadAti karmatisalajjameva | / tasyaiva bhAge krayavikrayotthaM / pApasya varge vyasanodbhavaM cha

7.text: mitrAshrayastho yadi shIrashmiH / karmAshritaH karma dadAti saumyam | / tasyaiva bhAge bahushAstrabhAjaM / vargottamastho makhajaM sadaiva

8.text: shatrvAshrayastho.ambarago nisheshaH / karma prasUte sutarAM nR^ishaMsam | / tasyaiva bhAge vanitodbhavaM cha / mUlatrikoNe nR^ipadaityajAtam

9.text: bhaumo.ambastastho yadi tu~NgasaMstho / yuddhodbhavaM karma dadAti puMsAm | / tasyAMshake dyUtasamudbhavaM cha / ShaDvargashuddhaH smarajaM nitAntam

10.text: nIchAshrito bhUtanayo.ambarasthaH / karma prasUte paradArajAtam | / tadaMshakastho gaNikodbhavaM cha / pApasya varge hyubhayaM sadaiva

11.text: mitrAshrayasthaH kShitijo.ambarasthaH / karma prasUte.akShamamuddhavaM cha | / tasyAMshakastho bahubhArajAtaM / vargottamasthaH praNayena hInam

12.text: shatrvAshrayasthaH kShitijo nabhogaH / karma prasUte bahudainyajAtam | / tasyaiva bhAge tvatha bhikShajaM cha / mUlatrikoNe.ambarakAShThajAtam

13.text: saumyaH svatu~Nge yadi karmasaMsthaH / karma prasUte dhanadhAnyajAtam | / tasyaiva bhAge cha chatuShpadotthaM / ShaDvargauddho gajavAjijAtam

14.text: nIchAshritaH somasuto.ambarasthaH / karma prasUte nijameva puMsAm | / tasyaiva bhAge paradeshajAtaM / pApasya varge khalajaM sadaiva

15.text: mitrAshrayasyaH shashijo.ambarasthaH / karma prasUte hayavikrayottham | / tasyaiva bhAge rajataM narANAM / vargottamastho.adbhutamitrajAtam

16.text: shatrvAshrayasthaH shashijo.ambarasthaH / karma prasUte bahukaShTajAtan | / tasyaiva bhAge guNavarjitaM cha / mUlatrikoNe suyashodbhavaM cha

17.text: jIvo.ambarastho yadi tu~NgasaMstho / dadAti karma prachuraM pradhAnam | / tadaMshakastho dvijapUjanotthaM / ShaDvargashuddhaH sujanArthanottham

18.text: nIchAshrito devaguruH sasaMsthaH / karoti karmAdhamalokasevyam | / tadaMshakastho.adbhutachauryajAtaM / pApasya varge.arthavivarjitaM cha

19.text: mitrAshrayastho dashame surejyaH / karoti karmANi shubhAni nityam | / tadaMshasaMstho nR^ipateH samutthaM / vargottamastho mahiShIgavottham

20.text: shatrvAshrayastho dashame surejyaH / karma prasUte satataM kR^itaghnam | / tasthaiva bhAge paravaMchanena / mUlatrikoNe nR^ipaterabhIShTam

21.text: tu~NgAshrayastho.ambarago bhR^igushcha / marma prasUte janavallabhaM cha | / tasyaiva bhAge maNimauktikADhyaM / ShaDvargashuddhaH kanakodbhavaM cha

22.text: nIchAshrayasthaH bhR^igujaH khasaMsthaH / karma prasUte vanitAshritaM cha / tasyaiva bhAge.alpasukhaM nitAntaM / pApasya varge guruduHkhajaM cha

23.text: mitrAshrayastho bhR^igujo.ambarasthaH / karoti karma prabhutAsametam | / tasyaiva bhAge nijabandhujAtaM / vargottamastho bahugauravADhyam

24.text: shatrvAshrayastho bhR^igujo.ambarasthaH / karma prasUte virajaM nR^ishaMsam | / tasyaiva bhAge bahuchintayADhyaM / mUlatrikoNe.anR^itasaMyutaM cha

25.text: tu~NgAshritaH sUryasuto.ambarasthaH / karma prasUte.atimR^idusthiraM cha | / tasyaiva bhAge bahushilpajaM cha / ShadvargashuddhaH priyasAdhvasaM cha

26.text: nIchAshritaH sUryasuto.ambarasthaH / karma prasUte dvijadrohajAtam | / tasyaiva bhAge nR^ipasevajaM cha / pApasya varge sanR^ishaMsarUpam

27.text: mitrAshrito bhAskarajashcha khasthaH / karoti karma prabhutAvihInam | / tasyaiva bhAge nR^ipasevajaM cha / vargottamastho mR^igayA sametam

28.text: shatrvAshrayastho.arkauto.ambarasthaH / karma prasUte bahukaShTajAtam | / tasyaiva bhAge parapaushunotthaM / mUlatrikoNe bhiShajodbhavaM cha

1.text: lAbhAshritastIkShNakaraH svatu~Nge / lAbhaM vidhatte gajavAjijaM cha | / tasyaiva bhAge mahiShisamutthaM / ShaDvargashuddhaH kanakodbhavaM cha

2.text: nIchAshrito vAsarapastu lAbhe / lAbhaM vidhatte jalapAdapAnAm | / tasyaiva bhAge cha kudhAnyakAnAM / pApasya varge parayoShitAM cha

3.text: mitrAshrayastho dinapastu lAbhe / lAbhaM prasUte suhR^idAM sadaiva | / mitrAMshakasthaH kulayoShitAno / vargottamastha pravarAryakANAm

4.text: shatrvAshrayastho dinakR^ishcha lAbhe / lAbhaM prasUte rathakambalAnAm | / tadaMshakasthaH khalamAnavAnAM / mUlatrikoNe guNinAM nitAntam

5.text: lAbhAshritaH shItakaraH svatu~Nge / lAbhaM vidhatte maNimauktikAnAm | / tasyaiva bhAge draviNAnnakAnAM / ShaDvargashuddhaH priyamAnuShANAm

6.text: nIchAshryastho himagushcha lAbhe / lAbhaM prasUte kukalatrakANAm | / tadaMshakasthastu susevakAnAM / pApasya varge parapaishunAnAm

7.text: mitrAshrayastho himagushcha lAbhe / lAbhaM vidhatte bahubandhavAnAm | / tasyaiva bhAge nadanartakAnAM / vargottamasthaH pravarArthakAnAm

8.text: shatrvAshrayastho himagushcha lAbhe / lAbhaM prasUte bahukandajAnAm | / tadaMshakastho hi mahIruhANAM / mUlatrikoNe kShitimR^idgR^ihANAm

9.text: bhaumaH svatu~Nge yadi lAbhasaMstho / lAbhaM vidhatte cha chatuShpadAnAm | / tasyaiva bhAge.atra subhakShakANAM / ShaDvargashuddho nR^ipamaNDalAnAm

10.text: lAbhAshrito bhUtanayastu nIche / lAbhaM vidhatte bahushauryajAtam | / tasyaiva bhAge bahuvaMchanotthaM / pApasya varge vadhabandhujAtam

11.text: mitrAshrayasthaH kShitijastu lAbhe / lAbhaM vidhatte nR^ipalokajAtam | / tadaMshakasthastu mahAjanotthaM / vargottamastho hyubhayaM sadaiva

12.text: shatrvAshryasthaH kShitijastu lAbhe / lAbhaM suvAte bahuvachakAnAm | / tasyaiva bhAge partarkakAnAM / mUlatrikoNe.adbhutabhUShaNAnAm

13.text: saumyaH svatu~Nge yadi lAbhasaMstho / lAbhaM suvAte bahushAstrajAtam | / tasyaiva bhAge vividhairupAyaiH / ShaDvargashuddhastvatha sarvavidhAm

14.text: lAbhAshritaH somasutastu nIche / lAbhaM vidhatte bahunIchasa~NgAt | / tasyaiva bhAge kR^itakAnusa~NgAt / pApasya varge.antyajalokapArshchAt

15.text: mitrAshrayasthaH shashijastu lAbhe / lAbhaM vidhatte paralokajAtam | / tasyaiva bhAge nijavidhayAto / vargottamastho vyavahAratashcha

16.text: shatrvAshrayasthaH shashijastu lAbhe / karoti lAbhaM vitathopachArAt | / tasyaiva bhAge kapaTairanekairmUlatrikoNe krayavikrayAbhyAm

17.text: jIvaH svatu~Nge yadi lAbhasaMstho / narendralAbhaM kurute narANAm | / tasyaiva bhAge nR^ipasevakAnAM / ShaDvargashuddhaH prachuraprabhAvAt

18.text: nIchAshrito devagurushcha lAbhe / lAbhaM narANAM kurute dhanaM cha | / nIchAMshakastho bhR^itakAhvayAnAM / pApasya varge bahukaShTatashcha

19.text: mitrAshrayathaH kurute surejyo / lAbhaM cha lAbhe rajatodbhavaM cha | / tasyAMshakastho bahudhAtujAtaM / vargottamasthaH sujanodbhavaM cha

20.text: shatrvAshryasthaH kurute surejyo / lAbhaM cha lAbhe puruShAdhamAnAm | / tasyaiva bhAge guNavarjitAnAM / mUlatrikoNe vividha \.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. jAnAm

21.text: shukraH svatu~Nge yadi lAbhasaMstho / lAbhaM suvAte sutabAndhavottham | / tasyAMshakastho nR^ipakanyakotthaM / ShaDvargashuddho dvitayasya chAsya

22.text: nIchAshrayastho bhR^igujastu lAbhe / lAbhaM vidhatte cha kupashyakAnAm | / tadaMshakasthastu kubuddhikAnAM / pApasya varge dvijaninditAnAm

23.text: mitrAshrayatho bhR^igujastu lAbhe / karoti lAbhaM varavAhanAnAm | / tasyaiva bhAge varasundarINAM / vargottamasthaH priyadarshanAnAm

24.text: shatrvAshraytho bhR^igujashcha lAbhe / karoti lAbhaM hatabAndhavAnAm | / tasyaiva bhAge gatasauhR^idAnAM / mUlatrikoNe sukhinAM sadaiva

25.text: saurochChasaMstho yadi lAbhasaMstho / lAbhaM vidhatte puruShottamAnAm | / tasyaiva bhAge dhanadhAnyakAnAM / vargottamasthaH pravarArchitAnAm

26.text: nIchAshritaH sUryautastu lAbhe / lAbhaM vidhatte bahupAtakAnAm | / tasyaiva bhAge jananarDitAnAM / pApaya varge mativarjitAnAm

27.text: mitrAshrayastho.arkasutastu lAbhe / lAbhaM vidhatte bahumitranAtam | / tasyaiva bhAge vanitAsamutyaM / vargottamasthaH shubhakaryalAbham

28.text: shatrvAshrayastho.arkasutastu lAbhe / lAbhaM vidhatte bahuvittajaM cha | / tasyaiva bhAge kR^imijaM sadaiva / mUlatrikoNe sthiradharmajAtam

1.text: vyayasthito vAsarapaH svatu~Nge / vyayaM vidhatte shru\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. lo\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. sa~NgAt | / tasyaiva bhAge gurusevakAnAM / ShaDvargashuddho dvijadeva\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. ryAt

2.text: nIchArayastho vyayagodinesho / vyayaM prasUte kujanAt kusa~NgAt | / tasyaiva bhAge vanitAnirodhAd / vargottamastho nR^ipasa~NgAmAshcha

3.text: mitrAshrayastho vyayago dinesho / vyayaM vidhatte bahumitrakArye | / tasyaiva bhAge kukalatratashcha / pApasya varge.antyajakAraNena

4.text: shatrvAshrayastho vyayago dinesho / vyayaM vidhatte gaNikAnusa~NgAt | / tasyaiva bhAge kujanAnurAgAn / mulatrikoNe janataH sadaiva

5.text: chandro vyayastho yadi tu~NgasaMstho / vyayaM prasUte.akShavidevanena | / tasyaiva bhAge krayavikrayAbhyAM / ShaDvargashuddho dvijasevanAshcha

6.text: nIchAshrayasthaH shashabhR^idjayastho / vyayaM prasUte paramArisa~NgAt | / tasyaiva bhAge paralokasa~NgAt / pApasya varge bahupApatashcha

7.text: mitrAshrayastho vyayagaH shashA~Nko / vyayaM vidhatte suhR^idAM prasa~NgAt | / tsyaiva bhAge nijabandhumAnAd / vargottamasthaH priyasa~NgamAshcha

8.text: shatrvAshrayastho vyayagaH shashA~Nko / vyayaM vidhatte ripulokatashcha | / tasyaiva bhAge bahudhA cha sarvaM / mUlatrikoNe nijabandhutashcha

9.text: bhaumo vyayastho yadi tu~Ngasamstho / vyayaM vidhatte raNajairvikAraiH | / tasyaiva bhAge paravaMchanena / ShaDvargashuddho raNajAdvikArAt

10.text: nIchArayasthaH kShitijo vyayastho / vyayaM vidhatte.antyajalokasa~NgAt | / tasyaiva bhAge vyasanairanekaiH / pApasya varge khalasa~Ngamena

11.text: mitrAshrayasthaH kShitijo vyayastho / vyayaM suvAte vitathaM narANAm | / tasyaiva bhAge pitR^ikarmajAtaM / vargottamasthaH suhR^idAnurAgAt

12.text: shatrvAshrayasthaH kShitijo vyayastho / vyayaM suvAte cha chatuShpadottham | / tasyaiva bhAge bahurogAta\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\.\. / mUlatrikoNe varabanditashcha

13.text: saumyo vyayastho yadi tu~NgasaMstho / vyayaM vidhatte bahugItavAdhaiH | / tasyaiva bhAge guNinAM prasa~NgAt / ShaDvargauddho.agniparigraheNa

14.text: nIchAshrayastho vyayagashcha saumyo / vyayaM prasUte dhanasa~Ngamena | / tasyaiva bhAge.adhamalokajAtaM / pApasya varge nR^ipalokadAnAt

15.text: mitrAshrathaH shashijo vyayastho / vyayaM suvAte bhumitrasa~NgAt | / tasyaiva bhAge nijabAndhavAnAM / vargottamastho vratinAM sadaiva

16.text: shatrvAshrayasthaH shashijo vyayastho / vyayaM suvAte sutajaM sadaiva | / tasyaiva bhAge sutadArajaM cha / mUlatrikoNe varabhogatashcha

17.text: vIvo vyayastho yadi tu~NgasaMstho / vyayaM prasUte gurulokadAnAt | / tasyaiva bhAge gurusevakAnAM / ShaDvargashuddho nijabAndhavAnAm

18.text: nIchAshrito devagururvyayastho / vyayaM suvAte vyavahArajAtam | / tasyaiva bhAge tu kusIdajAtaM / pApasya varge vaNijotthameva

19.text: mitrAshrayastho vyayagaH surejjyo / vyayaM vidhatte paravAdatashcha | / tasyaiva bhAge paradeshasa~NgAt / vargottamasthaH praNayAnurodhAt

20.text: shatrvAshrayastho vyayagaH surejyo / vyayaM suvAte vyasanairvichitraiH | / tasyaiva bhAge mativibhrameNa / mUlatrikoNe suratoparodhAt

21.text: shukro vyaystho yadi tu~NgasaMstho / vyayaM prasUte vratajairvikAraiH | / tasyaiva bhAge bahushAstraragAt / ShaDvargashuddhaH priyasa~Ngamena

22.text: nIchAshrayastho bhR^igujo vyayastho / vyayaM vidhatte nR^ipalokasa~NgAt | / tasyaiva bhAge pararoShatashcha / pApasya varge daytashcha nityam

23.text: mitrAshrayastho bhR^igujo vyayastho / vyayaM vidhatte bahubhakShaNena | / tasyaiva bhAge bahupAnayogAd / vargottamasthaH kShitijairvikAraiH

24.text: shatrvAshraya bhR^igujo vyaystho / vyayaM prasUte raNakarmayogAt | / tasyaiva bhAge janaviplavena / mUlatrikoNe vitathopachAraiH

25.text: mando vyaystho yadi tu~Ngasamstho / vyayaM suvAte.adhamakarmajAtam | / tasyaiva bhAge.adhammitrasa~NgAt / ShaDvargashuddho nijabandhudoShAt

26.text: nIchAshritaH sUryasuto vyayastho / vyayaM prasUte.antyajamAntashcha | / tasyaiva bhAge.adbhutavAdasa~NgAt / pApasya varge nijabandhanena

27.text: mitrAshraytho ravijaH prasUte / vyayaM vidhatte bahumitrarodhAt | / tasyaiva bhAge sutadAsadoShAd / vargottamasthaH praNayaprakopAt

28.text: shatrvAshryastho.arkasuto vyayastho / vyayaM suvAte karaNAnurodhAt | / tasyaiva bhAge bahulaulyadoShAn / mUlatrikoNe priyasa~NgamAshcha
